CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Discount_Type__c,'%'), ( Discount_Value__c* Unit_Price__c)/100, IF(ISPICKVAL( Discount_Type__c,'Price Override'), (Base_Total1__c - Discount_Value__c)/ Quantity_Unit__c , IF(ISPICKVAL( Discount_Type__c,'Base Price Override'), (Base_Total1__c - Discount_Value__c)/ Quantity_Unit__c, Discount_Value__c )))
CustomField.label: Discount Amount/Unit
